bio: A swift chick with a blonde fringe of feathers across its eyes. It writes a song about every bird that ever flew past it, and the bird always knows.
Its crest has grown into the shape of a microphone. It sings each verse twice: once the old way, then again so that the new one is the one it owns.
Its feathers change colour with each era of its life, and it keeps every one. When it flies over a town, the town's hotels fill up for the weekend.
note: Remembers everyone who was ever mean to it, by name.
Sings the bridge louder than the rest.
Announces its next era before this one is over.
